name: @local/omp-minimal-output
description: Grok-build-style minimal console output for omp

opacity.description: Row text opacity (0–1). Indicator stays full color.

indicator.description: Live/settled row mark: diamond (◈◉◎○/◆), dot (●○◉○/●), none (space).

indicatorAnimation.description: Cycle live indicator frames at 120ms. Off uses the first frame.

nativeBash.description: Leave bash on the native Ohmypi renderer.

nativeRead.description: Leave read on the native Ohmypi renderer (also disables the read-group skin).

nativeGrep.description: Leave grep on the native Ohmypi renderer.

nativeGlob.description: Leave glob on the native Ohmypi renderer.

nativeWrite.description: Leave write on the native Ohmypi renderer.

nativeEdit.description: Leave edit on the native Ohmypi renderer.

nativeEval.description: Leave eval on the native Ohmypi renderer (boxed Output).

nativeWebSearch.description: Leave web_search on the native Ohmypi renderer.

nativeTask.description: Leave Task on the native Ohmypi renderer and leave its result text untouched.

taskMaxAgents.description: Maximum agents shown in an expanded minimal Task card.

nativeHub.description: Leave Hub on the native Ohmypi renderer and leave its result text untouched.

hubMaxItems.description: Maximum items shown in an expanded minimal Hub card.

webSearchMaxResults.description: Maximum sources shown in the expanded minimal web-search card.

todosHeader.description: Show live todos in the sticky header (expand/collapse via /todos).

todoHud.description: Show the native TODO HUD above the editor. Off hides it; the plugin widget remains if todosHeader is on.

todoReminderOneLine.description: One-line warning/error panes (todo reminder, TTSR, notify, error banner). Off leaves native boxes.

editShowTabs.description: Show tabs as → in edit diffs.

editShowSpaces.description: Show spaces as · in edit diffs.
